The '''Iorwerth Camp''' is a small camp outside [[Prifddinas]], occupied by [[elf warrior]]s under the command of [[Lord Iorwerth]]. The [[Regicide]] [[Quests|quest]] needs to be started to access it, as well as at least 45 [[Agility]]{{Boostable|yes}} to pass obstacles along the way through the forest.

==Transportation==
The Iorwerth Camp can be reached in several ways, all of which require partial (or full) completion of [[Regicide]]. Listed here in order from closest to furthest:

* {{Plink|Iorwerth camp teleport}} — camp centre.
* {{Plink|Spirit tree|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — Prifddinas, a short walk north of the village.
* {{plink|Charter ship|pic=War ship}} — Port Tyras, slightly south of the camp (costs {{Coins|3200}}).
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{fairycode|BJS}} — island west of the camp (requires 76 [[Agility]] to leave the island).
* {{Plink|Zul-andra teleport}} — Zul-Andra, south of the camp.
* {{plink|Teleport crystal}} — Lletya, east of the poison waste.

From Port Tyras, the camp is reached from the following path: north, east, south, east, north, west, north.

== History ==
Sometime in the [[Fourth Age]], the son of [[Lady Iorwerth]] overthrew his mother to lead the [[Iorwerth Clan]]. Obsessed with finding the fragment of [[Seren]], the elven goddess, he eventually started a civil war over the elven city of Prifddinas; this culminated in the other elven clans singing a powerful song that turned Prifddinas into a crystal seed, frozen in time, until Iorwerth was dealt with. He set his camp up outside the city as he planned to return it to its city form.

After several hundred years, Iorwerth struck a deal with King Lathas in order to further control of [[Isafdar]]. In the process, he found the location of the [[Temple of Light]], where it was believed that Seren's fragment resided. After bringing an adventurer that was working to thwart Iorwerth's schemes to the camp, Iorwerth revealed his true plan to restore Seren via the fragment. The adventurer and [[Arianwyn|an elven companion]] eventually fought back against Iorwerth in one of his attacks, mortally wounding Iorwerth. The camp then went to [[Lord Iestin Iorwerth|Lord Iestin Edern Iorwerth]], the new leader of the Iorwerth Clan.

==Features==
The camp is small, featuring four tents. One tent contains a loom, and another contains a [[STASH#Master|master STASH unit]]. The other two contain nothing but a bed and some stools.

A [[Fishing spots|fishing spot]] can be found to the north-west of the camp. Here, players can catch [[Raw shark|sharks]], which can be cooked on one of the two everlasting [[fire]]s in the camp. Slightly to the south-east, there are lure/bait fishing spots. Players needing more feathers may kill the [[chicken]]s in [[Port Tyras]] to replenish.

Finally, a few regular [[trees]] stand around the camp, and a small [[Iorwerth Camp cave|cave]] at the north of the camp is visited during [[Song of the Elves]]. The cave cannot be entered after the quest has been completed.

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===

* {{Chatl|Arianwyn}} (during [[Song of the Elves]])
* {{Chatl|Elena}} (during [[Song of the Elves]])
* {{Chatl|Lord Iestin Iorwerth}}, the successor to Lord Iorwerth
* {{Chatl|Lord Iorwerth}}, the leader of the camp and Iorwerth Clan (prior to completion of Song of the Elves)

=== Monsters and attackable NPCs ===
The following are the protectors of Iorwerth Camp. You can attack them but be prepared, as they have high defence and can hit fairly hard. The warriors can be [[Safespot|safespotted]]. If the player has not completed [[Song of the Elves]] and thus no access to [[Prifddinas]], it is highly recommended to fight elves in [[Lletya]] instead, since there is both a [[bank]] and an [[altar]] available there.

Note that if a player enters the camp during Song of the Elves, after the death of [[King Lathas]], the elves will be aggressive toward the player. 
*[[Iorwerth Archer|Iorwerth archer]] (x6)
*[[Iorwerth Warrior|Iorwerth warrior]] (x6)
